verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents file-format importers (glTF, OBJ, STL) and DCC exporters for Max/Maya/Blender, plus headless Node.js/NullEngine support, but nothing in the evidence describes an actual asset-pipeline automation system — import hooks, presets, or batch/pipeline scripts that process incoming assets without manual per-asset handling. Missing for 10: documented CLI/pipeline scripting API for batch asset ingestion, preset/hook configuration system, and any independent confirmation of pipeline automation in production use.
